from scipy.stats import linregress
import numpy as np

# In 1.16.0, x and y must be specified separately
x = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4])
y = np.array([2, 3, 5, 7])
result = linregress(x, y)

entries.before:
from scipy.stats import linregress
import numpy as np

# In 1.15.3, linregress could infer x and y from a single argument
x_and_y = np.array([[1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 5], [4, 7]])
result = linregress(x_and_y)
assert result is not None
entries.title: scipy.stats.linregress no longer accepts single argument x for inference
